title: Tamsin and the Summer
author: Gideon Halloran
blurb: Ansel Sandoval, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
